name: CRS-29 Resupply Mission
description: SpaceX's 29th resupply mission to the International Space Station, delivering cargo and experiments to support the crew aboard the ISS.

name: Starlink Group 6-1
description: Launch of the sixth group of Starlink satellites to expand global internet coverage. Falcon 9 deployed 60 Starlink satellites into low Earth orbit.

name: Axiom Space Mission 3
description: Third crewed commercial space station mission with Axiom Space. Four private astronauts traveled to the ISS for research and maintenance operations.

name: GPS III Space Vehicle 06
description: Launch of the sixth next-generation GPS satellite for the U.S. Space Force. These satellites provide enhanced military and civilian navigation services.

name: WorldView Legion Mission
description: Launch of high-resolution Earth imaging satellites for Maxar Technologies. These satellites provide detailed satellite imagery for commercial and government applications.

name: Transporter-7 Rideshare
description: The seventh dedicated rideshare mission deploying 115+ small satellites and payloads. This cost-effective launch enables startups to reach orbit.

name: USSF-67 National Security Mission
description: Launch of classified U.S. Space Force payload using Falcon Heavy. The triple-core rocket delivered a national security satellite to geosynchronous orbit.

name: Viasat-3 Americas
description: Launch of the advanced Viasat-3 broadband satellite. Falcon Heavy delivered the massive telecommunications satellite to geosynchronous orbit for global internet coverage.

name: USSF-44 Space Force Mission
description: U.S. Space Force national security space launch utilizing Falcon Heavy's heavy-lift capability. Payload deployed to high-energy transfer orbit.

name: Starship Integrated Flight Test 1
description: First integrated flight test of the fully stacked Starship vehicle. Despite RUD (rapid unscheduled disassembly), the test achieved valuable data for vehicle development.

name: Starship Integrated Flight Test 2
description: Second integrated flight test with improved Booster and Ship. The vehicle reached space and completed a controlled reentry and ocean splashdown.

name: Starship Integrated Flight Test 3
description: Third integrated flight test demonstrating continuous improvements. Ship hot staging was achieved, advancing toward engine separation in space.

name: Starship Integrated Flight Test 4
description: Fourth test flight achieving booster catch attempt and advanced Ship testing. Represented significant progress toward orbital refueling capability.

name: Crew-7 Dragon Crewed Mission
description: Launch of four astronauts on Crew Dragon for a six-month expedition to the International Space Station. Falcon 9 delivered the capsule to orbit.

name: Palantir StarShield-5
description: Launch of synthetic aperture radar imaging satellite for national security. Falcon 9 delivered the advanced reconnaissance spacecraft to polar orbit.

name: Intelsat 901 Relocation
description: Launch of Intelsat 901 telecommunications satellite. The mission involved relocating the satellite to a new orbital slot for improved service coverage.
